gold_sql: SELECT count(*) AS flow_count FROM network_flows WHERE source_dataset = 'ctu13_s4' AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP '2011-08-15 10:42:52.613616' AND event_time < TIMESTAMP '2011-08-15 10:42:52.613617'
